spec_reference: spec/announce.md §2.5 worked handshake example (informative) + the §6.1/§6.3/§6.4 framing clauses
scope_note: DIFFABLE, not COVERED: a foreign reader byte-diffs each frame's exact wire bytes (endianness, field width, padding) against its own encoder; this does NOT cover the untested KISS-Announce clauses or the reader/decline paths.
population: the FIVE §2.5 worked-example POSITIVE frames only: the 56-byte envelope, the availability list, and the CYRQ/CRSP/CDEC request-response frames. NOT rendered here: malformed/decline vectors (announce_golden.rs exercises the reader's typed declines in Rust), envelopes with >1 profile or other capability sets, and any frame type absent from §2.5 — that is the burn-down this artifact makes measurable, not part of it.
